DRAFT · for the Chief of Staff · not sent · send now, before counsel briefs Mrs. King for 4 November · updated 21 Oct after counsel's reply 
From: Jonathan Paul Zschoche, attorney-in-fact of Patricia Keesey Zschoche 
To: Atty. Bonifacio T. Barandon, Jr. 
Date: ____ October 2026 
Re: Civil Case No. 26-360, Mrs. King on 4 November

Atty. Barandon,

Thank you for your reply of 21 October. Since Mrs. King is next, here is what her own cases with the Balane side show, for your briefing with her.

**No one ever decided ownership.** On 28 July 2020 the Provincial Prosecutor wrote that his office "cannot pass upon the issue of ownership" and advised the parties "to file appropriate civil action." He repeated it on 16 September 2020, and mailed that resolution to the respondents, Jomil Torralba and Nelly Juntilla, on 23 September 2020. The Daet courts and the Court of Appeals, in her perjury case, recite the same ruling.

**The Balane side had the revocation before registration.** Her Verified Answer in Civil Case 8563, with the three Bicol Post notices attached, was stamped received by Atty. Aquino's office, counsel for Jomil and Nelly, on 9 July 2021. Gloria's title issued on 23 November 2021. Nelly is Gloria's attorney-in-fact under the 28 May 2020 power attached to their Answer.

**Three things for her briefing.**

1. If Atty. Ramos raises her perjury case, the answer is short: she was charged and acquitted. That opens re-direct on what was decided about ownership, and on what she attached to her 2021 Answer and to whom it was served.

2. Her Ruby Ferrer house (2015) stood on the lot Gloria bought. Ramos will call her a rival claimant. She should say only what she bought and that she does not claim the title.

3. In her affidavit, Q9 says the defendants knew the plaintiffs were the owners. She cannot speak to what they knew; withdrawing those words on direct removes a motion to strike.

You already have Mrs. King's own copies of these records: her Verified Answer in Civil Case 8563 with the receipt stamps; the prosecutor's two resolutions; the orders in Criminal Case 20-6030; and her acquittal and the Court of Appeals resolutions. On re-direct she can identify her own Answer and the stamp it carries. If the court records are offered on rebuttal against Princess and Jomil, certified copies may be needed; I can obtain them when you say. The point of law is yours: whether notice to Gloria's attorney-in-fact, or to that side's lawyer, binds Gloria.

**What I need from you before you brief Mrs. King:** (1) whether you want these records used on re-direct if the door opens, or kept for rebuttal only; (2) whether you want certified copies of the court and prosecutor records for rebuttal, and by when; (3) whether your office has ordered the transcript of the 14 October hearing. If not, may your office request it? I will pay the fees and would like a copy to check my testimony.

With respect, 
Jonathan Paul Zschoche
